user_request_examples: Create two robots that pass an object between them
Set up a multi-robot scene with coordinated manipulation
Build a handover system where robots exchange objects
Make two arms work together to transfer an item
scenario_description: Two Franka Panda robots mounted on elevated platforms (1.6m apart) coordinate to hand over a cylindrical object. Robot 1 picks the object from a source table, moves to a handover zone, and holds it steady. Robot 2 reaches to the handover zone, grasps the object, and both release/grasp in coordination. Robot 2 then places the object on a target table. This demonstrates multi-robot coordination, synchronized motion, and shared object manipulation.

handover_zone.description: Mid-air point equidistant from both robots

object.graspable: Both robots can grasp along cylinder axis

complexity_factors.coordination: Robots must synchronize motion and grasp timing
complexity_factors.shared_object: Both robots manipulate same object during handover
complexity_factors.elevated_bases: Robots on platforms, different from typical table-mounted setup
complexity_factors.timing_critical: Handover requires precise coordination: robot 1 holds, robot 2 grasps, robot 1 releases
complexity_factors.collision_avoidance: Robots must not collide during approach to handover zone

expected_behavior.0-3s: Robot 1 picks object from source table
expected_behavior.3-7s: Robot 1 moves to handover zone; robot 2 simultaneously reaches to handover zone
expected_behavior.7-8s: Robot 2 closes gripper on object (dual grasp)
expected_behavior.9-12s: Robot 1 returns home; robot 2 holds object
expected_behavior.12-16s: Robot 2 moves object to target table
expected_behavior.result: Object successfully transferred from source to target table via coordinated handover

validation_criteria.successful_pick: Robot 1 lifts object from source table
validation_criteria.successful_handover: Object transfers from robot 1 to robot 2 without dropping
validation_criteria.dual_grasp_stable: Object remains stable when both robots grasp
validation_criteria.successful_place: Object placed on target table within 1cm of target
validation_criteria.no_collisions: Robots do not collide during handover

handover_zone_reachability.symptom: One or both robots cannot reach handover zone
solutions: Move platforms closer (1.4m separation instead of 1.6m)
Ensure robot 2 grasps before robot 1 releases (add 0.5s delay)
Verify robot 2 gripper is fully closed

robots_collide.symptom: Robot arms collide near handover zone
solutions: Adjust handover zone to avoid robot workspace overlap
Use different approach angles for each robot
Stagger timing: robot 1 arrives first, robot 2 approaches after

gripper_fight.symptom: Both grippers apply opposing forces, object unstable
solutions: Robot 1 holds position (stiff), robot 2 applies gentle force
Use force control instead of position control during dual grasp

timing_desynchronization.symptom: Robots arrive at handover zone at different times
solutions: Use event-based coordination instead of time-based
Adjust trajectory speeds to match arrival times

extensions.heavy_object: Require both robots to lift together throughout
extensions.mobile_bases: Robots on mobile platforms, navigate to handover
extensions.vision_guided: Detect handover zone and object pose with cameras
extensions.force_feedback: Use force sensors to detect successful grasp
